About us:

Dudaji is an IT development company that knows AI well.

In Korea, we are developing services using AI such as VisionAI and natural language processing.

Representatively, there is a copyright protection solution.

It is headquartered in Korea and has development centers in Vietnam and Southeast Asia.

In collaboration with the Vietnamese development team, we also launched a translation and communication app called Middo.

(https://middo.app)

Recently, we have collaborated with a large Korean game company to publish in the Asian market.

The mainly used technology stack is as follows.

Kubernetes, React.js(vue.js), PyTorch, Unity

data.title: DevSecOps Manager
data.content:
• V-Key is one of the world’s leading deep-tech companies in mobile cyber-security. Our patented technology V-OS has been deployed by top banks, mobile payment providers, and governments to secure software solutions and protect more than 150 million users globally.  
  • We are rapidly expanding into new markets and new customer segments. Apart from securing digital transactions for everyone, we are also enabling new generation technology by providing the cybersecurity infrastructure for banking, government and smart homes, among many others.  
  • At V-Key, we are building towards a future where technology users can enjoy unprecedented security and convenience.  
  • We are looking for an DevSecOps Manager, as part of the IT & DevOps Department.
